c5e9a14b17.q: What is Cut A Rug Tufting and how does the workshop experience work in Huntsville?
c5e9a14b17.a: Cut A Rug Tufting is a workshop-style art class at Lone Mill where customers learn to make their own rugs using tufting guns, similar to the videos seen on TikTok. Participants receive instruction from Brent Hobbs and take home a finished rug. The experience accommodates groups of four to six people maximum, though single-person classes are also available, and the studio operates with a high foot traffic location that attracts walk-in customers.

30d4863c61.q: How many Christmas vacation cat rugs has Brent Hobbs hand-made and sold on Etsy since creating the design?
30d4863c61.a: Brent Hobbs has made approximately 2700 Christmas vacation cat rugs by hand, all cut out with scissors. These rugs feature the scene from National Lampoon's Christmas Vacation where the cat chews the lights and gets fried, and they sell primarily between October and Christmas. Each rug takes about 15 minutes to make from start to finish, and they are sold on Etsy under the shop name B Creative Dad.

a3da896e6b.q: How long has Brent Hobbs been operating Cut A Rug Tufting at Lone Mill in Huntsville?

9c0bb0481a.q: What are Brent Hobbs' future goals for Cut A Rug, including private events and new art forms?
9c0bb0481a.a: Brent Hobbs plans to expand Cut A Rug by offering private event services where he brings a slimmed-down version of the tufting workshop to corporate locations for team-building exercises and employee benefits. He is also exploring paint pouring workshops on collectible vinyl bear figures as a way to accommodate younger children under age 14, who currently cannot participate in the tufting classes.
